hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools (YES/NO share tokens) implementing a VALS formula fee: fees are computed from trade size, pool liquidity, and a signed toxic-velocity parameter (sigma) provided per-swap via hookData. Captured fees are routed to a YieldDistributor for share token holders rather than LPs. Also tracks LP virtual balances and updates pool prices for yield accounting.
